help.text:
PSXTERM · by seregonwar

F1  Help                     F2  Flash actions
F3  Switch / add console      F4  New terminal
F5  Reconnect                F6  Tabs / split
F7  Rename                   F8  Close terminal
F9  Focus sidebar            Ctrl+Q  Quit
F10 Toggle sidebar
Alt+1…8 / Ctrl+PgUp/PgDn      Switch terminal
Shift+PgUp/PgDn / wheel      Scroll history
Ctrl+End                     Return to live output

In sidebar: ↑↓ select, Enter focus, N new terminal.
Mouse selects consoles, tabs, panes and actions.
× closes that terminal after confirmation.
Tab, Esc and Ctrl+C reach the terminal when no dialog
is open. Ctrl+D sends PTTY/1 EOF.

Flash commands open a dedicated terminal.
Tokens entered in the form stay in memory only;
PSXTERM_TOKEN can supply a token at the next launch.
F5 resumes suspended sessions while the daemon retains them.
Switch consoles without closing existing terminals.

License: GNU GPLv3, no warranty.
F2 → license displays the original full license.
F2 → language changes language (saved in preferences).
PSXTerm service port: usually 2323. 9021 is the loader.

F2 search: action names, abbreviations or /command IDs.
The palette shows shortcuts and availability.
Below 72 columns the sidebar becomes a compact rail.
F9 opens its drawer; F10 toggles its visibility.
Split automatically adapts to space without closing sessions.

Drag to select terminal text; release to copy.
Ctrl+Shift+C copies the selection or visible terminal.
F2 → colors switches readable / original ANSI colors.
New output or resizing cancels an active selection.

F11 / F2 → search finds text in terminal output and history.
Literal search ignores case and joins automatically wrapped rows.
Enter / ↓ next, Shift+Enter / ↑ previous; Home/End first/last.
F5 refreshes results; Esc closes search without remote input.
New output or resized panes require refreshing the search.

F12 / F2 → export saves the current terminal text locally.
Choose visible output or all retained history, then Enter save.
Tab changes focus; arrows change scope; Ctrl+U clears the path.
Existing files are never overwritten. The workspace stays usable
while saving; quitting cancels an unfinished export.

Dialog fields: ←→ move the caret; click places it in the text.
Home/End or Ctrl+A/E go to the start/end; Delete removes ahead.
Paste inserts at the caret; Ctrl+U clears the field.
In search and the palette, Home/End select first/last result;
use Ctrl+Home/End or Ctrl+A/E to move within the query.
